WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT p.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_sum
  FROM payment AS p
  JOIN rental AS r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
  JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  GROUP BY p.rental_id, i.store_id
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT store_id, AVG(payment_sum) AS avg_payment_sum
  FROM step1
  GROUP BY store_id
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT s1.rental_id, s1.store_id, s1.payment_sum,
         s1.payment_sum - s2.avg_payment_sum AS difference
  FROM step1 AS s1
  JOIN step2 AS s2 ON s1.store_id = s2.store_id
  WHERE s1.payment_sum > s2.avg_payment_sum
)
SELECT store_id, SUM(payment_sum) AS sum_payment_sum,
       AVG(difference) AS avg_difference
FROM step3
GROUP BY store_id
